student.welcome.title: Barka da dawowa! Mu saita burin yau 🎯
student.welcome.body: Danna maɓallin Saita don zaɓar wasanni nawa kake son kammala a wannan makon. Lambun ka yana girma yayin da ka kai burin!
student.welcome.firstBody: Zaɓi darasi na farko a ƙasa don farawa samun XP. Buri na mako zai buɗe bayan wasan ka na farko!
student.streakReminder.neverStarted.titl: Shirya don shuka ranar ka ta farko? 🌱
student.streakReminder.neverStarted.body: Ranar ka ta farko wasa ɗaya ce kawai! Kwashe yau, san abokin ka na sabo, ka girma iri ɗaya ya zama abin mamaki. Muna goyon bayan ka!
student.streakReminder.broken.title: Ai — ka dawo! Muna ƙaunar ka 💛
student.streakReminder.broken.body: Hutawa ba laifi ba ce — jarumai ma yana huta. Rikodin ka na {longest} rana yana jiran ka, kuma wasa ɗaya kaɗai yau za ta dawo da ka kan hanya!
student.streakReminder.brokenFreeze.titl: Tske! Daskarar ka ta cece streak din ka ❄️
student.streakReminder.brokenFreeze.body: Daskarar ta kiyaye streak din ka — har yanzu kana da {current} rana{s}! Kwashe yau ka sake ƙunar da wutar.
student.streakReminder.inDanger.title: Streak na {current} rana — mu ci gaba da haskaka shi! 🔥
student.streakReminder.inDanger.body: Wasa ɗaya kaɗai yau tana rike da streak din ka — da ƙarin XP ɗinka. Na san za ka iya!
student.streakReminder.onFire.title: {current} kwanaki a jere — kana cin wuta! 🔥
student.streakReminder.onFire.body: Muna alfahari da kai saboda komowar ka kowane rana! Kwashe wasa ɗaya yau ka samu ƙarin XP yayin da wutar ka ke bikin.
student.streakReminder.legend.title: Almarar {current} rana! 🌈
student.streakReminder.legend.body: Wai — {current} rana! Kai ne daya daga cikin manyan EliteKids. Kwashe yau ka ci gaba da sihirin XP na 3× ka nuna musu yadda ake yi!
student.streakReminder.comeback.title: Rana {current} — kana gwani! 🌟
student.streakReminder.comeback.body: Kana gina abin mamaki, rana daya bayan daya. Kwashe wasa yau kuma manna Super Star ta kusa!
